response.text:
Since you have a W-2 job as a project coordinator and a side business selling candles, your candle income will be treated as self-employment income. That means you'll owe both income tax and self-employment tax (Social Security/Medicare) on the profits.

The good news is you already keep a monthly budget in a spreadsheet—you can use that to track business expenses (like supplies, packaging, and marketing) to lower your taxable profit. Would you like to walk through what counts as a deductible expense, or discuss whether you should be making quarterly estimated tax payments?
